Fortin, you are aware, aren't you, that fifty gets you kicked out?''"<br />"''They didn't tell me that, sir. They didn't even tell me what a degrade ''was''.''"<br />"''We don't tell you everything. So if I were you, I'd follow the rules.|[[Maggis]] and [[Trever Flume|Fortin]]|<ref name="AtE">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref>}}
The '''Mining Corps''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was formed in response to the need for raw materials and natural resources for the Empire's vast manufacturing ventures. Laborers of the Mining Corps originated from many sources, including [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and individuals that failed in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
